raw_segments.text: So subdued I was by those tears, and by their breaking out again in the course of the quiet
walk that when I was on the coach and it was clear of the town, I deliberated with an aching
heart whether I would not get down when we changed horses and walk back and have another
evening at home and a better parting. We changed, and I had not made up my mind and still reflected
for my comfort that it would be quite practicable to get down and walk back when we changed
again. And while I was occupied with these deliberations, I would fancy an exact resemblance
to Joe and some man coming along the road towards us, and my heart would beat high,
as if he could possibly be there.
